title: slot map
description: Written by the builder to <world>/kantobridge/slot_map.json. Gives every (atlas, palette, tile, shape) the export uses a tile block: family f of that shape (kantobridge:tile_<shape>_<ff>) and slot s (block state hi = s >> 4, lo = s & 15). Derived from the whole export, never from a build's map filter, and authoritative in multiplayer. The WorldIndex's slotMapHash is the SHA-256 of this file's canonical JSON. Entries are sorted by atlas, palette, tile, shape.

atlas.description: The export image id of the tileset atlas.

palette.description: The SGB palette the tile is coloured with.
